place_fields.vibe: Seasonal Western Ghats waterfall near Karnataka-Goa border
place_fields.summary: Kalasa Falls, also called Kanakumbhi in visitor sources, is a seasonal waterfall in the Surla-Kanakumbi area. Supplied coordinates preserved exactly.

planning_attributes.description: Visitor sources describe a monsoon waterfall reached by a short nature trek in the Surla area; map data places it near Kanakumbi and Parwad.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Sources place the falls in the Surla-Kanakumbi area near Parwad and Chorla; a short trek is described from the surrounding access area.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Natural terrain is wet and uneven during monsoon; use caution.

place_fields.micro_region: Sundi village, Chandgad taluk, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra
place_fields.vibe: Seasonal monsoon waterfall in rural Western Ghats
place_fields.summary: Sundi Waterfall is a seasonal waterfall near Sundi village, close to the Karnataka border. Sources describe a short approach through fields to the falls.

planning_attributes.description: Visitor reporting describes a monsoon attraction near Sundi village with a short walk from roadside parking through fields and a descent to the waterfall.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: A local travel source reports about 50 feet; this is an approximate reported height, not an independently verified measurement.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Sources place the falls near Sundi village; the final approach is a short walk through fields from roadside parking, followed by steps or a rocky descent.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Current reports conflict: a July 2026 report says the falls remained prohibited, while recent local reporting describes ticketed access. Check current local authority status before travel.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Uneven rocky terrain and monsoon water can increase risk; use caution near the water edge.
